utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’m glad you’re starting on the east side.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’m on it. If I run into any trouble, Rey said she can help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, that should keep things moving. I’ll check in after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Oren can come by and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll keep the list tidy and let Bo know what’s still needed for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, that should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Tess'll keep folks posted if she hears anything else, and Dane can take the rest of the tasks and help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can be there right after pickup and keep an eye on the timing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that covers timing. I’ll tell Kira and keep things moving if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can tell Jules to spread the word, and I’ll ask Rey once we know what snag stopped the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring my spare tarps and screws, and Sam can help once you’ve pinned down the snag.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it — I’ll tell Jules to spread the word, and once we know what snag hit the drive, I’ll check with Rey.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s still set for 4:30, and I’m keeping to that. Let me know if the plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Sunday at the community center still works for me. I’ll keep the repair drive moving and follow the rest of the plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Sunday at the community center is settled then. I’ll keep an eye on the plan and expect it to stay at 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything else for the repair drive. Cleo’s got spare tarps and screws, and Kira’s getting ready too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center is still the plan, right? I’m just trying to keep the timing and hands sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Sunday at the community center is still the plan. I’ll let you know if I hear any change on timing or who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it, and I’ll keep spreading the word to the neighbors as replies come in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now, and if anyone still needs a note, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: It’s at 4:30, right? We still need to sort the tarps and screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the count again, but I think we still need a little more for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, 4:30. I think we still need a bit more, but Cleo’s tarps and screws should help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help once you tell me what snag came up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: The snag is the roof patch and a few fence boards. I’m sorting that first, then we can both get to work.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it. I can help with the roof patch and the fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep passing it along. Roof patch and fence boards are the main things people need to know about.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll take the rest and help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure folks know roof patch and fence boards are the priorities.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds good. I’ll swing by after errands and see what still needs doing if you’ve got extra hands lined up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll spread the word and round up a few more hands so Ira has people to check in with.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out after errands and see what still needs doing once your extra hands show up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Right, I still only know the porch screen and one gate latch from second-hand updates. If you have the full list, I’m happy to hear the exact total.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That sounds about right, but I’d still want the exact total before we start. If Oren can help, we should be able to knock out the loose hardware and those latches pretty quickly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That tracks. Once you have the exact total, I’m in on getting the porch screen and latch work done.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word and round up a few more hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm Oren’s coming, and do we still need the porch screen and that gate latch?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help once we know what snag came up on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center still stands, and if Leo comes up short, you can step in on the rest or help sort the order list and what's still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, then I can handle the rest or help sort the list if Leo still needs backup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Right, let’s keep the repair drive focused on the roof patch and the fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll keep an eye out and let Tess update folks if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Bo. We’ll keep it on the roof patch and the fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mina said she’s got the full repair list and can go over the exact total, but I still think the porch screen and one gate latch are on it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got spare tarps and screws if Mina needs them, and Sam can help with the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Right, that sounds like the pieces Mina would know for sure. I’ll wait for her exact total before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got you on the list, Oren, and I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll be there with an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word and we’ve got enough hands now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll note the main pickup spots and flag whether any need a truck or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me. I can be there right after pickup and keep an eye on the timing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep the pickup spots clear and note anything that needs a truck or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the rest of the repair drive tasks and help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, it’s at 4:30 now. I’ll check what still needs fixing and let Cleo know about the tarps and screws.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll keep an eye out and jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still here, and Oren can head over to help. I’ll let Ira know what’s left after errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep passing the word along and make sure folks know the roof patch and fence boards are the priorities.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll tell Ira once I’m back, and I’m glad Oren can take the next bit over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Jules can spread the word and bring a few more hands, and Rey can jump in once we know what snag hit the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing. Jules can start calling folks right now for extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Ira. I’ll keep Rey in the loop once we spot the snag, and Jules can keep lining up more hands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Oren can come by and help with the repair drive. Once Dane starts the inventory list, Mara can take the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works. Once Dane starts the inventory list, I’ll take the rest of the repair drive work.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Once Dane starts the list, you take the rest and Oren covers the drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s still set for 4:30, and I’m sticking with that unless Vik says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything else for the repair drive. Cleo’s got tarps and screws if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to know. I’ll wait for Vik’s word and keep the 4:30 plan unless it changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list tidy so Bo stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Is there anything else you still need for Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Not much more right now, just keeping the list in order and making sure Bo has the latest.
